item.title: 🇮🇳 INDIA: TELEFORCE CLOUD TELEPHONY OPERATOR GARUDA ADVERTISING DOCUMENTS ALLEGEDLY LEAKED A threat actor on an underground forum claims to have...
item.description:
🇮🇳 INDIA: TELEFORCE CLOUD TELEPHONY OPERATOR GARUDA ADVERTISING DOCUMENTS ALLEGEDLY LEAKED

A threat actor on an underground forum claims to have leaked a business folder allegedly belonging to Garuda Advertising Pvt. Ltd., the Gurgaon-based company behind the Teleforce cloud telephony, contact-centre and ad-tech platform.

The post describes about 140 documents, including:
* 106 sales proposals and pitch decks
* About 1,070 proforma invoices (March 2025 to October 2026)
* A June 2026 response to an insurer's RFP for a dialer and AI contact-centre solution
* Service agreements, a vendor KYC form, price lists and quotations

The actor says the files expose the company's bank details, two directors' names and home addresses, names, addresses and GST numbers of about 1,000 customers, company tax and registration IDs, and negotiated prices and bid details.

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
The post is unusually specific about file counts and date ranges, which suggests the actor had real access to a document set, but no sample files are shown on the page. The data is mostly commercial rather than mass consumer PII.

This is an unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a compromise of Garuda Advertising or Teleforce systems.

If genuine, invoice and bank details enable convincing invoice-fraud and payment-diversion emails to Teleforce customers, and leaked pricing and bids hand rivals a commercial edge.

item.title: 🇻🇪 VENEZUELA: BETTING WEBSITE "ROYALE" USER DATA ALLEGEDLY LEAKED BY TERROAHGROUP A threat actor on an underground forum claims to have leaked p...
item.description:
🇻🇪 VENEZUELA: BETTING WEBSITE "ROYALE" USER DATA ALLEGEDLY LEAKED BY TERROAHGROUP

A threat actor on an underground forum claims to have leaked part of a database allegedly belonging to "Royale", a betting website with a presence in Latin America (reported as Apuestas Royal).

The post claims the data includes:
* Emails
* Passwords
* ID numbers
* Phone numbers

The actor says this is "just the first part" and that the rest is in the possession of TerroahGroup. A short sample of email:password lines and phone numbers was posted as proof (redacted here).

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
The visible sample is small and the post gives no total record count or file size. The phone numbers in the sample use Venezuelan mobile prefixes, which fits a Venezuela-facing betting site, but the operator is not named beyond "Royale". TerroahGroup has recently made other claims against Venezuelan targets.

This is an unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a compromise of the betting operator.

If genuine, users who reuse the same password elsewhere face credential-stuffing risk, and phone numbers plus ID numbers could fuel betting- and payment-themed fraud.

item.description:
Goa CM Pramod Sawant (@DrPramodPSawant) posts on 'X', "Goa Legislative Assembly, Porvorim Pleased to attend and address the 25th Anniversary of the New Goa Legislative Assembly Complex in the presence of Hon’ble Speaker of Lok Sabha Shri @ombirlakota ji, Hon'ble Governor Shri Pusapati Ashok Gajapathi Raju ji, Hon’ble Speaker of the Goa Legislative Assembly @DrGaneshGaonkar and distinguished guests. This occasion is not merely a celebration of a building, but of 25 years of debates and deliberations, Questions and Answers, legislation, scrutiny and, above all, the voice of the people being expressed through their elected representatives. From the first sitting of Goa’s Legislature at Old Secretariat in 1964, through Goa’s Statehood in 1987, to the inauguration of this Complex in 2000, our legislative journey reflects the continuous evolution of Goa’s democracy. The Assembly has also embraced technology, with Goa being an early pioneer in the transition towards a paperless Legislature and subsequently adopting digital platforms such as NeVA, making legislative information more accessible to citizens. As we look towards the next 25 years, let us reaffirm our commitment to responsible debate, accountable governance, empowered citizens and a progressive Goa. 25 Years of the New Assembly Complex. Over six decades of Goa’s Legislative Democracy. A stronger Legislature. A stronger Goa."

(Photo Source: Pramod Sawant's 'X' handle)

item.title: 🇯🇵 🚨 OSAKA METROPOLITAN UNIVERSITY CONFIRMS RANSOMWARE ATTACK — CLASSES CANCELLED, MOST CAMPUS SYSTEMS DOWN One of Japan's largest universit...
item.description:
🇯🇵 🚨 OSAKA METROPOLITAN UNIVERSITY CONFIRMS RANSOMWARE ATTACK — CLASSES CANCELLED, MOST CAMPUS SYSTEMS DOWN

One of Japan's largest universities says a large-scale failure of its virtualization platform, which began in the early hours of Oct 2 (JST), was caused by a cyberattack it has determined to be ransomware.

What OMU says:
• Servers began shutting down around 0:20 AM JST on Oct 2; signs of partial data tampering were found
• Down: campus network, OMU email, university websites, staff portal, academic and education-support systems, the admissions information database, finance, HR/payroll and library systems
• A crisis headquarters led by the president is investigating with outside specialists
• Whether personal data was leaked is still under investigation; Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission, MEXT, police and JPCERT have been notified

⚠️ Analyst Note:
The university has not named the attackers or said whether a ransom was demanded, and no group has publicly claimed the attack. Media reports of 130,000+ potentially affected people are not confirmed in OMU's statement.

Students, staff and applicants: watch for phishing that uses the outage or OMU's name.

Source:
https://www.omu.moe/news/2026-10-06-7fb5a624.html

#DDW #DarkWeb #Ransomware #Japan #Education #CyberSecurity

item.title: Delhi Police press release reads: INDI Alliance द्वारा 06.10.2026 को निर्वाचन आयोग की ओर मार्च | दिल्ली पुलिस ...
item.description:
Delhi Police press release reads: INDI Alliance द्वारा 06.10.2026 को निर्वाचन आयोग की ओर मार्च | दिल्ली पुलिस को सोशल मीडिया के माध्यम से जानकारी प्राप्त हुई कि INDI Alliance Bloc द्वारा 06.10.2026 को सुबह करीब 10:30 बजे संसद भवन से निर्वाचन आयोग (ECI) के कार्यालय की ओर मार्च निकाला जाएगा।

प्रस्तावित मार्च के आयोजन के संबंध में अनुमति हेतु कोई आवेदन उपायुक्त पुलिस, नई दिल्ली जिला के कार्यालय में प्रस्तुत नहीं किया गया था। अतः उक्त प्रस्तावित मार्च के लिए कोई अनुमति प्रदान नहीं की गई थी।

प्रस्तावित जमावड़े तथा नई दिल्ली क्षेत्र में भारतीय नागरिक सुरक्षा संहिता (BNSS) की धारा 163 के अंतर्गत लागू निषेधाज्ञा के उल्लंघन की आशंका को दृष्टिगत रखते हुए कानून एवं व्यवस्था बनाए रखने, भीड़ की आवाजाही को नियंत्रित करने तथा किसी भी अप्रिय घटना को रोकने के लिए लिए आवश्यक सुरक्षा व्यवस्था की गई थी।

मार्च करीब 10:30 बजे शुरू हुआ। प्रदर्शनकारियों ने पुलिस द्वारा लगाए गए पहले बैरिकेड को तोड़ा और आगे बढ़ते हुए नीति आयोग के निकट लगाए गए दूसरे बैरिकेड तक पहुंच गए।

पुलिस द्वारा बार-बार घोषणा कर प्रदर्शनकारियों को धारा 163 BNSS के तहत लागू प्रतिबंधों की जानकारी दी गई और उनसे शांतिपूर्वक वापस जाने की अपील की गई। इसके बावजूद प्रदर्शनकारियों ने पुलिस के निर्देशों का पालन नहीं किया और वहां बने रहे।

वैध निर्देशों की लगातार अवहेलना तथा स्थिति को नियंत्रित करने और कानून-व्यवस्था बनाए रखने के उद्देश्य से पुलिस द्वारा कानून के अनुसार प्रदर्शनकारियों को निरुद्ध किया गया। लगभग 260 व्यक्तियों, जिनमें 10 सांसद भी शामिल हैं, को निरुद्ध कर दिल्ली के विभिन्न पुलिस थानों में ले जाया गया, जहां उनके संबंध में आवश्यक कानूनी कार्रवाई की जा रही है।

इसके बाद अधिकांश प्रदर्शनकारी वहां से चले गए। हालांकि, श्री राहुल गांधी, सुश्री प्रियंका गांधी, श्री के.सी. वेणुगोपाल, श्री पवन खेड़ा, श्री मनीष उष्म और करीब 50-60 समर्थक बिना अनुमति के आकाशवाणी भवन परिसर में प्रवेश कर वहां बैठ गए।

श्री राहुल गांधी ने आकाशवाणी परिसर से बाहर जाने से इनकार कर दिया और कहा कि जब तक सांसदों के प्रतिनिधिमंडल को निर्वाचन आयोग (ECI) से मिलने के लिए समय नहीं दिया जाता, तब तक वे वहां से नहीं जाएंगे।

कानून-व्यवस्था बनाए रखने तथा स्थिति को और बिगड़ने से रोकने के लिए दिल्ली पुलिस को प्रदर्शनकारियों को वहां से हटाने की कार्रवाई करनी पड़ी। इस कार्रवाई के दौरान श्री राहुल गांधी, सुश्री प्रियंका गांधी सहित अन्य प्रदर्शनकारियों को भी परिसर से हटाया गया और आवश्यकतानुसार निरुद्ध किया गया। कार्रवाई कानून के अनुसार की गई तथा इस दौरान कानून-व्यवस्था एवं सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा को प्राथमिकता दी गई।

दिल्ली पुलिस द्वारा क्षेत्र में पर्याप्त सुरक्षा और कानून-व्यवस्था की व्यवस्था की गई है। स्थिति पर लगातार नजर रखी जा रही है। सभी संबंधित व्यक्तियों से शांति बनाए रखने और पुलिस द्वारा दिए गए वैध निर्देशों का पालन करने की अपील की जाती है।

VIDEO | Chandigarh: On CBI raids at Punjab CM's camp office in Sector 2, AAP national media in-charge Anurag Dhanda says, "What is being discussed across the country at present is that the BJP cannot win elections through the electoral process. The BJP cannot win even a single election on its own. It is winning elections across the country by stealing votes. In Punjab too, the people did not open their doors to them. So, they now want to intimidate the Punjab Chief Minister and the people of Punjab through the CBI and ED. The BJP does not know the history of Punjab. They may have formed governments by rigging elections in Bihar and Bengal, but if the BJP knows Punjab's history, it should understand that Punjab does not bow down to anyone. Punjab will give them a befitting reply in their own language."
